summary.text: Cory Thornton is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Mark Speed.
His campaign website describes him as a Marine veteran and businessman.

paragraphs.text: Thornton's campaign website says he has lived in District 7 since age six and enlisted in the United States Marine Corps at 17, deploying to Japan, Thailand and Iraq.
It says he has built multiple businesses in construction, real estate, entertainment and recycling, and earned an MBA from the Jack Welch Management Institute.
The site also says he serves as a deacon at Cedar Rock Baptist Church and as a trustee of Vance Granville Community College, and that he is married with five daughters.
